name: Okanta Cavalier (CR 1/3)
body:
OKANTA CAVALIER
CR 1/3

XP 135
Okanta cavalier (aethership pilot) 1
NG Medium humanoid (okanta)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+7 armor)
hp 13 (1d10+3)
Fort +4, Ref +0, Will +0; +2 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities fearless
Weaknesses light sensitivity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)
Melee Large earth breaker +5 (3d6+6/x3) and gore +0 (1d6+2)
Special Attacks challenge 1/day (+1 damage, +1 to hit while riding speeder), tactician 1/day (Intercept Charge, 3 rds)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 10, Con 15, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 14
Base Atk +1; CMB +5; CMD 15
Feats Intercept Charge, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics –7 (–11 to jump), Fly –3 (+4 when piloting), Intimidate +6, Perception +1, Sense Motive +4 (+5 when opposing a Bluff check)
Languages Hymnas, Okantan
SQ aethership bond, adaptive mimicry, order of the sword, powerful build
Gear potion of cure light wounds; Other Gear Large earth breakerUE, splint mail, standard aetheric capacitor (60 au)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adaptive Mimicry (Ex)

Once per day This NPC may spend 1 hour observing a creature actively using any skill that he has no ranks in. After this observation period This NPC gains a number of ranks in the observed skill equal to its level and treats the skill as a class skill if it is not already such. This effect lasts until This NPC dedicates time to studying a different skill in use, which then replaces its previous selection. This ability does not grant This NPC access to uses of a skill that are normally prohibited (such as the Elemental Harmony skill unlock for Perform) that he would not otherwise have.

Light Sensitivity

This NPC is dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

Powerful Build (Ex)

Whenever This NPC is subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for an opposed check (such as grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), he is treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to him. This NPC is also considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as improved grab or swallow whole) can affect him. Additionally, he can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, its space and reach remain those of a creature of its actual size. The benefits of this racial trait stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change the subject’s size category.

Sword’s Challenge +1 (1/day) (Ex)

Once per day, This NPC can challenge a foe to combat. As a swift action, This NPC chooses one target within sight to challenge. This NPC’s melee attacks deal extra damage whenever the attacks are made against the target of its challenge. This extra damage is equal to the This NPC’s level. This NPC can use this ability once per day. This NPC takes a –2 penalty to its Armor Class, except against attacks made by the target of its challenge.

The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious or until the combat ends. Whenever This NPC issues a challenge, he receives a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls against the target of its challenge so long as he is astride its speeder.

Tactician (Intercept Charge, 3 rds, 1/day) (Ex)

As a standard action, This NPC can grant the Intercept Charge feat to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear him. Allies retain this feat for 3 rounds.
